question_text: A database imports dates from offices in several countries. Outline why using one consistent date representation matters.
adaptation_rationale: Retains data consistency reasoning without requiring a particular ISO standard or assuming text dates equal native date types.
solution: A consistent representation avoids interpreting a day as a month or vice versa.; This improves comparison, sorting and data integrity when records are combined.
